Notes

LOWFI/1 power ratings

LOWFI/1 reads scores, not just results, and adjusts for who each team has played. The raw scoring ranks sit beside the model's, and the gap between them are the opponent and other adjustments at work.

LOWFI/0 true strength

LOWFI/0 is the original model, and it only sees wins and losses. True strength is its estimate of how often a team beats an average opponent, and the number beneath it is how much it still doesn't know. Win percentage and Pythagorean percentage are what's actually happened so far, for comparison - Pythagorean is what the points scored and allowed say the record should be.

Projections

Both models run through the same simulation engine, so a cell in one table compares directly with the same cell in the other. Projected point differential is the differential so far plus the average of every simulated game still to play.

Over time

Every point is what that Tuesday's run said, before that week's games - nothing is refit after the fact. The panels are grouped by conference and division, and the rank chart follows each team's place among all 32 from week to week.
